days.title: Vélez-Blanco Heritage and Caves
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Almacén de Trigo
stops.detail: It has an information office in the “Almacén de Trigo”, in Vélez-Blanco (visitor center).

stops.name: Cueva de los Letreros
stops.detail: The cave paintings of the Cueva de los Letreros are one of the most important archaeological treasures of Almería.

stops.name: Maimón Grande
stops.detail: It is located in the municipality of Vélez-Blanco sheltered by a wall of Maimón Grande.

stops.name: Castillo de los Fajardo
stops.detail: The Fajardo Castle presides over the municipality of Vélez-Blanco.

days.title: Natural Monuments and Botanical Sites of María and Chirivel
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Umbria de la Virgen
stops.detail: In the reforestations of Sierra María, maritime pine (Pinus pinaster) was also used at middle elevations, with Umbria de la Virgen (in the municipality of María) being the area where this species has developed with the greatest vigor.

stops.name: Jardín Botánico "Umbría de la Virgen"
stops.detail: The "Umbría de la Virgen" Botanical Garden, in the site that gives it its name, contains a rich variety of native species serving as a sample of the park's botanical wealth.

stops.name: ermita de la Virgen de la Cabeza
stops.detail: In the month of April, the inhabitants of the neighboring regions make a pilgrimage to the hermitage of the Virgen de la Cabeza, in the heart of the park, in the municipality of María.

stops.name: sabina albar de Chirivel
stops.detail: A specimen of Juniperus thurifera stands out, considered millennial, the Spanish juniper of Chirivel, declared a natural monument of Andalusia.

days.title: Baroque Architecture and History of Vélez-Rubio
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Iglesia parroquial de la Encarnación
stops.detail: The historic center of Vélez-Rubio, in which several stately residences and the town hall stand out, possesses an authentic jewel of the Baroque; it is the imposing Parish Church of the Incarnation of cathedral dimensions and majestic bearing.

stops.name: Museo Comarcal Velezano "Miguel Guirao"
stops.detail: The Velezano Regional Museum "Miguel Guirao" has its headquarters in the old Royal Hospital of Vélez-Rubio, which has an interesting regional archaeological collection.
